(1) the sequential peer-assisted delivery scheme is asymptoticaly optimal in terms of bandwidth surplus, and that (2) the peer-assisted delivery becomes self-sustaining as the number of peers increases.

the simple sequential download scheme is asymptoticaly optimal both in the surplus and in the deficit mode, and the system becomes totally self-sustained in the surplus mode when the number of users is large.

peer-assisted video distribution systems can become self-sustaining as the number of peers grows, and that the sequential scheme is optimal in the sense that it minimizes the server bandwidth requirements.
